items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Sarah had me, I made an orchestration for her.

ctx.x: Okay, so go on with your story about Earl Hines.

Sarah, she came on -- I told Earl Hines that we got a kid here tonight that's great, a Sarah Vaughn, and she won the contest, see, and Sarah had me, I made an orchestration for her. Once in awhile -- and that Johnny Hodges, he took, he made -- obligato, and Duke made a number out of it called -- da, da, da, da ... no.
He made a big number out of it, see, and Earl took Sarah that same night -- they have never looked back, Ella -- and Pearl Bailey came later, see.

items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughan was on this night, Earl Hines was the band

ctx.x: I remember that because I was there.
And play for them and we went into the Apollo Theatre and Sarah Vaughan was on this night, Earl Hines was the band, so I said to Earl --
